newsitem.title: UK: BFI up nine as prompt Panamaxes remain tight.
newsitem.headline: BFI up nine as prompt Panamaxes remain tight.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up nine to 1,320 points on Monday.
Brokers said the freight market remained generally unchanged with the important exception of Panamaxes, especially in early positions.

Mitsubishi fixed NSAC tonnage for 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Taiwan for July 10/23 at a significantly higher $22.95 and EMC were forced to concede a very firm $13.55 to Halla tonnage for 54,000 heavy grain NoPac to Taiwan for July 4/15.

Brokers said it was believed that Halla have now covered this position on timecharter with the 1983-built Lamyra 64,800 dwt delivery prompt South Korea for a North Pacific round voyage at a very firm $9,000 daily.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was five points higher to 20 points lower and turnover was 20 lots.
